CFML Language Reference: Functions

PreserveSingleQuotes

Inside CFQUERY, single quotes in the values of CFML variables are doubled automatically so that a name like O'Brien cannot break the SQL. PreserveSingleQuotes switches that off for one variable, so you can insert prepared pieces of SQL that contain quoted strings.

Category

Other functions

Syntax

PreserveSingleQuotes(variable)

Parameters

variable
The variable whose single quotes must be passed through unchanged.

Returns

The value of the variable, unescaped.

Usage

Use it for SQL fragments your code assembled, such as a WHERE clause or an IN list built with ListQualify. Never use it on raw form or URL input: that would let visitors run their own SQL. The function only has an effect inside CFQUERY; elsewhere it returns its argument unchanged.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET Wanted = ListQualify("Sales,Marketing", "'")>
<CFSET Where = "Department IN (#Wanted#)">
<CFQUERY NAME="Staff" DATASOURCE="cfsnippets">
SELECT FirstName, LastName, Department FROM Employees
WHERE #PreserveSingleQuotes(Where)#
ORDER BY Department, LastName
</CFQUERY>
<CFOUTPUT><P>WHERE #Where# finds #Staff.RecordCount# people:</CFOUTPUT>
<UL>
<CFOUTPUT QUERY="Staff">
  <LI>#FirstName# #LastName# (#Department#)
</CFOUTPUT>
</UL>
